description: The shared Renovate preset for every Those Who Run v2 repository, which extends it pinned to a release: "extends": ["github>those-who-run/.github#vX.Y.Z"].
Every update waits in one PR per repository per week, which the maintainer reviews and merges by hand; security fixes open at Renovate's next run, in a PR of their own.

The cooldown holds a version update until the release is 7 days old. A release without a timestamp (GHCR and other registries than Docker Hub publish none) is held until a rule exempts it, as the organisation's own images, workflows and template are below.
tests/test_renovate_preset.py checks the decided values below.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: it would open a PR of its own outside the weekly one.

pre-commit.description: Off by default in Renovate. The hooks are pinned by commit SHA with the tag in a `# frozen:` comment, which Renovate keeps.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Fixes for GitHub's Dependabot alerts: at Renovate's next run, in a PR of their own, not held by the schedule, the group or the cooldown, and not auto-merged. No `enabled` here: Renovate forces this object onto each alert's rule, and a forced `enabled: true` would override a repository's packageRules entry that disables a dependency.

packageRules.description: The commit hooks run on the maintainer's machine at every commit, so they wait longer, as in v1.

The organisation's own images, which it builds. GHCR publishes no release timestamps, so under the cooldown they would wait for ever. timestamp-optional keeps them moving should a later rule set a cooldown again.
This repository's own releases: the reusable workflows every repository calls, and this preset's pin. Same principle as the images: the organisation wrote and reviewed them.

chassis's releases, which a repository made from the template takes through the copier manager. Its git-tags lookup has no release timestamps, so under the cooldown they would wait for ever. The URL is the one `copier copy` was given, with or without .git.
